title: Zxro's Vanilla+
description:
Beautiful Graphics, Speedy performance and similar features in an all new Pack.

Out for 1.21.8 now!
body:
# Zxro's Vanilla Plus
A Simple Minecraft Modpack Focussing on Performance, Graphic enhancements and some Quality of life Changes while Keeping to the Vanilla Minecraft we all know.

## Performance
Zxro's Vanilla+ is faster than most competing game clients, thanks to our modern performance mods. The bundled mods have been carefully selected to be safe and provide speed and performance unlike most others.

## Vanilla but better
although Zxro's Vanilla+ has some changes to the classic Vanilla experience like adding the [Dungeons and Taverns Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns) to spice up exploration and really emerse into a new minecraft vanilla experience, it still allows you to play Minecraft as you remembered it, no matter what version you played before.

## Up to date
Zxro's Vanilla+ recieves fast updates and will update to new versions as soon as possible. updating the modpack is easy and will preserve mod settings where possible.


## Vanilla Tweaks
Massive Thanks to [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) for letting me use their service for this pack, check them out!
